title: MV Aria/Dawn of sorrow soul system

posts.author: riku5690
posts.body:
So i got a fun idea that fits lore wise and i thought it could be fun but couldn't find if anyone else did it. So I wanted to have aria/dawn of sorrows soul system in my game.
For those that don't know, basically after you kill an enemy, there is a chance for you to gain a skill from that enemy so for example, if you kill a skeleton that throws bones, you can get the skill to throw bones as well.
I wanted to know if there is a plugin for such a thing in rpg maker mv or a way to set that up. I was using VE_enemyskill plugin but thats only to use a learn ability or just get hit by it, not kill the enemy for the skill.

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
You can do it with just troop events (with Hime End Phase Triggers). Just check if the enemy HP is 0, control random variable for chance and a conditional to learn the skill. Then you'll need to check which actor acted last. There might be a script for that, but there's also the official DLC plugin in STEAM folder KadokawaPlugins 'LastSubjectActor'.
Or you can do it with Yanfly stuff, check after action if the target is dead (or hp 0) and then reference the target notetags where you've written the skill id and make the user learn the skill.

posts.author: woootbm
posts.body:
You have to equip the souls, right? So you just need an equipment slot named “soul” and make them loot drops with low odds to drop. The armor items then have “learn skill” trait.
To make it less jank you’d need a plugin that makes the item only drop once but otherwise everything is base functionality (unless you want a fancy animation when the soul is collected, then do rpglord’s way).
